title: ACSAN: All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network Integrating Convolutional Operations with Vision Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2610.35375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. translated_title: ACSAN：将卷积运算与视觉Transformer相融合的全卷积自注意力网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35375v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：在过去几年中，视觉Transformer（ViT）在计算机视觉领域取得了卓越的性能。然而，仍然存在一些问题。例如，由于ViT仅包含大量可训练参数，因此严重依赖大规模训练数据，这降低了其学习效率，并限制了其在资源受限场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的深度学习模型，即全卷积自注意力网络（ACSAN），该模型采用卷积运算来替代ViT框架中的全连接矩阵乘法。为实现ACSAN，我们首先设计了动态卷积自注意力（DCSA）作为基础模块，该模块采用多尺度膨胀卷积来生成Query、Key和Value。我们分别定义了空间自注意力和通道自注意力来生成注意力特征，最终将这两种注意力特征融合……
tldr: 提出ACSAN模型，通过动态卷积自注意力（DCSA）模块用多尺度膨胀卷积替代ViT中的全连接矩阵乘法，并结合空间自注意力与通道自注意力，从而减少参数量和对大规模训练数据的依赖，使其更适用于资源受限的场景。
en_tdlr: ACSAN replaces fully-connected matrix multiplications in Vision Transformers with multi-scale dilated convolutions through a Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) module that combines spatial and channel self-attention, reducing parameters and dependence on large-scale training data for resource-constrained scenarios.
